ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Cruelty.cs:18-21) == cost 1 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.rationale: `new PowerVar<CrueltyPower>(25m)` (Cruelty.cs:14) == `_power_amount = 25`. The value is a PERCENTAGE the power adds to Vulnerable's multiplier, not a damage number, and both sides carry the raw 25.

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<CrueltyPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["CrueltyPower"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (Cruelty.cs:26) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, CrueltyPower, self._power_amount, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (25) and the Vulnerable hover tip (16).

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars["CrueltyPower"].UpgradeValueBy(25m)` (Cruelty.cs:31) == `self._power_amount += 25` (25 -> 50). Note the upgrade DOUBLES rather than increments -- checked against the source, not assumed.
